The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 这是古代的故事：这是一个古代的故事
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 从他的家到墓地很近：他的家离墓地很近
- 所以他每天老是从早到晚去墓地跟朋友们玩玩儿：delete老是；玩儿，V.V. is used to make requests or plans

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 从他的家到墓地很近：他的家离墓地很近，use 离 to state that two places are close; 从……到…… normally introduces a route or distance, such as “the road from A to B.” [vocab list]

items.reason: 表示两个地点相距很近时应说“离……很近”，而“从……到……”不适合直接作此类距离状态表达。
